args.body: Hi Amelia, thanks for letting us know. Your tap repair is already booked (ref R-4801): Swift Plumbing & Heating are due on Thursday 15 October, 8am-12pm. We haven't opened a second job, but we've added a note that the drip is now constant, and will ask the contractor whether they can come sooner. If there's a isolation valve under the sink (a small slotted screw or lever on the pipe), turning it off will stop the drip until the visit. If the water starts to run rather than drip, or reaches anything electrical, please tell us straight away. We'll update you by Monday 12 October.
